facts.fact: BCEAO runs PI-SPI, the instant payment platform for UEMOA members including Guinea-Bissau, launched 30 September 2025 with 175 connected participants a year later.
Guinea-Bissau is a UEMOA member in the BCEAO's PI-SPI regional instant payment system, in service.

BCEAO runs PI-SPI, the instant payment platform for UEMOA members including Niger, launched 30 September 2025 with 175 connected participants a year later.
Niger is a UEMOA member in the BCEAO's PI-SPI regional instant payment system, in service.
